sql: select strategy, count(*) n, round(avg(pnl*100.0/nullif(quantity,0))::numeric,4) mean_cents, round(stddev_samp(pnl*100.0/nullif(quantity,0))::numeric,4) sd_cents, round(min(pnl*100.0/nullif(quantity,0))::numeric,2) min_c, round(max(pnl*100.0/nullif(quantity,0))::numeric,2) max_c from paper_trades where strategy in ('mmsellA4','mmsell10') and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and created_at >= '2026-08-16T14:14:43Z' group by strategy
